info.name: GlintPM Private — Local
info.description: Stage 0 (health) + Stage 1 (auth + organizations) + Stage 2 (projects, budget, progress, payments, dashboard) + Stage 3 (variations, risks, issues) + Stage 4 (inspections, evidence, documents with versioning) endpoints. Run 'Login' first — it saves {{access_token}}/{{refresh_token}} to the environment automatically, and every authenticated request below uses Bearer {{access_token}}. For file-upload requests, select a real file from your machine in the 'file' form field.
